review_kind: read-only historical exact-W source and evidence review

findings.result: No source-level mapping or arithmetic-order defect found. Each lane has sub=lane%8; XOR-1 with shuffle width 8 exchanges the complementary uint4 half within the same 8-lane block subgroup. Selection reconstructs the same a0/a1 words as the non-cooperative branch before unchanged nibble extraction, scale/min arithmetic, and dot expression.

No source-level mapping or arithmetic-order defect found. Four-lane groups correspond to q=0..3. High words are sourced from lane j; low words from (q&1)+2*(j&1), matching ql pointer parity and base+word addressing. Nibble extraction, signed 6-bit conversion, scale application, and dot expression are unchanged. Source-level per-lane word loads fall from 16 to 6 per decoded slice, with added shuffles; this does not establish reduced DRAM traffic.

Direct path is gated to SM86, Q4_K/Q6_K, rows divisible by 128, columns above vector limit, valid K/row-byte/output-stride geometry, and selected launch with no stream-K fixup. It writes the same float MMQ sum through __float2bfloat16; accumulate reads existing BF16, converts to float, adds, and rounds back, matching store_plane arithmetic order. Unsupported conditions return false or reject and caller retains normal float-plane path.

Referenced balanced result records 3 complete launch pairs (2 baseline-first, 1 candidate-first), 36 requests per arm, all listed identity/workload/output-hash gates passed, pair improvements 5.1128716%, 5.2096141%, 5.2820813% (mean 5.2015223%).

static_scope: Reviewed pinned git source and listed receipts only; no source edits.
limitations: Static review is not an exhaustive proof of every runtime path or architecture.
Only recorded corpus/output hashes and runtime gates are covered by the evidence artifact.
Three independent launch pairs are too few for a stable high-confidence population interval; resampling these three deltas understates uncertainty.
Original B0 image has no captured CMake option receipt, so comparison does not identify causal per-flag contributions.
No build, Docker, WSL, GPU timing, or source modification was performed.
